from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u052/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 8 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] != 8 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            colored = [(y,x) for y,x in cells if grid[y][x] != 0]
            if not colored:
                continue
            top, bottom = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            left, right = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            mt, mb = min(y for y,x in colored), max(y for y,x in colored)
            ml, mr = min(x for y,x in colored), max(x for y,x in colored)
            tile = [grid[y][ml:mr+1] for y in range(mt,mb+1)]
            th, tw = len(tile), len(tile[0])
            for y in range(top,bottom+1):
                for x in range(left,right+1):
                    out[y][x] = tile[(y-mt)%th][(x-ml)%tw]
    return out
'''
